name: io.github.knowledgestack/ks-mcp
description: Knowledge Stack MCP server — semantic, keyword, and hybrid search, document reading, citations, schema-shaped extraction, image retrieval, and path browsing over a tenant-scoped knowledge base.

environmentVariables.name: KS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the KS API host. Defaults to https://api.knowledgestack.ai.

environmentVariables.name: KS_TIMEOUT_S
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for upstream KS calls. Defaults to 30.

environmentVariables.name: KS_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR). Logs go to stderr. Defaults to INFO.
